record.name: Close
record.one_liner: A sales CRM platform that manages leads, contacts, opportunities, and activities.
record.access_note: Developers can create a free secondary organization or request a free dev organization.
record.api_note: Covers core CRM concepts like leads, contacts, opportunities, activities, custom fields, and pipelines.

evidence.quote: Two methods are supported: API Keys — Best for scripts... OAuth 2.0 — Best for user-facing integrations.
Already a Close user — You can create a free secondary organization.
Close uses industry-standard REST conventions with predictable URL structures, standard HTTP methods, and JSON request/response bodies.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers provide a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model or agent
